title: GreenFaaS: Carbon-Aware Scheduling for Serverless Workloads
description: Reference implementation and discrete-event simulator for GreenFaaS, a carbon-aware scheduler for serverless (FaaS) workloads. Version 1.1.0 adds a GreenCourier-style baseline, the multi-baseline comparison, the equal-guard interactive-routing comparison, the runtime-crossover experiment and a long-deadline stress test, with the result tables accompanying the IEEE Transactions on Services Computing revision (TSC-2026-06-0840).
